description: React component for the Sessions page in a data management dashboard, including data fetching, filtering, pagination, and visualization with charts and a data table.

methods.name: distinctSorted
methods.description: Helper function to get distinct, sorted, non-empty string values from an array.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts snake_case keys to Title Case labels for display.

methods.name: buildRestrictedColumns
methods.description: Builds DataTable column definitions based on allowed fields, with custom render logic.

methods.name: loadAggregates
methods.description: Fetches session data across multiple pages to build client-side aggregates for charts.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches session data from server with pagination, filtering, and sorting.
